name: Receipt Lookup Tool
description: Tool for fetching receipt information. Use start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings. Example: for March 2026, use start_date: '2026-03-01' and end_date: '2026-03-31'.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). If not specified, use '1900-01-01'.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). If not specified, use '2099-12-31'.

inputs.name: store_name
inputs.description: The store name. If not specified, use 'ALL'.
